item.title: Hugging Face - Wikipedia
item.description: Hugging Face, Inc., is an American company based in New York City. Its online platform allows users to share datasets and machine learning models. It also develops open-source machine learning libraries, notably the Transformers library. [3] Hugging Face agreed to an acquisition by Nvidia in August 2026.

item.description: Hugging Face is an open-source AI platform that provides pre-trained models, datasets and tools to build Natural Language Processing, computer vision, audio and generative AI applications. It helps developers to use AI models without training everything from scratch.
